scoring_justification: T1 recompute: the checker reads the agent's pt_table.csv, verifies the optimal-row threshold, and compares the pt values for several reference parameter combinations against digitized values from the paper's Figure 4.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference pt values for trend comparison, digitized from Figure 4 of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually digitized from the published chart; values cross-checked against the paper's claim and the expected trend from the reference solution.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from the only published source of predicted pt values for these parameter combinations; the hidden gold is necessary to verify the parametric trend claimed in the paper.

outputs.description: Table of (r, b, t) geometry combinations and the corresponding portion-of-thickness pt where h ≥ 0.97.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the submitted pt values against hidden reference values (the optimal-condition threshold and digitized trend from the paper) using appropriate tolerances.

steps.description: Scores the entire pt_table.csv by checking the optimal-row condition and agreement with paper trend.
